description: Gap report for the 20 closed_verified tennis editions migrated to this branch. Produced via round-transition ghost detection (R32-onward, byefree per validated M1000 method in phase1-audit/WORKORDER_Phase1_DrawSize_Gap_Audit.md Phase 1B). A gap = a player appearing in round N+1 with no traceable win recorded in round N within the same edition file.
method: For each edition, for each transition in [R32->R16, R16->QF, QF->SF, SF->F]: collect all playerA/playerB in round N+1; collect all winners (resolved via winner field + playerA/playerB) in round N; any round-N+1 participant absent from round-N winners is a gap. R64->R32 excluded uniformly (bye-affected at this draw depth, not a genuine gap) per the same exclusion applied to M1000 in Phase 1B.
